{{Quote|Do you know what this is, Korsin?''"<br />"''Cyanogen silicate?|Seelah and Yaru Korsin|<ref name="Paragon" />}}
'''Cyanogen silicate''' was a chemical compound utilized in medicine by [[Doctor/Legends|doctors]] and healers of both the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Old Sith Empire]]. The [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Species/Legends|species]]' [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] warrior caste used the compound as a powerful cauterizing agent, and the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Seelah Korsin]] framed [[Ravilan Wroth]] and his fellow [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] for the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of a hundred thousand native [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] whom she had [[Poison/Legends|poisoned]] with [[cyanogen]] silicate. Over a thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, the [[xenopathologist]] [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Archiban Kimble]] used cyanogen silicate as part of his cure for a [[Suudaa Nem'ro's disease|flesh-eating disease]].

==Description==
{{Quote|It's bad enough on its own. But if moisture gets into it, it breaks down&mdash;and intensifies a thousandfold. One particle per billion could do anything.|Seelah Korsin|<ref name="Paragon" />}}
A chemical compound, [[cyanogen]] silicate was used as a cauterizing agent in its solid form to heal the wounds of the [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] warrior caste of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Species/Legends|species]], as their tough hides proved resistant to treatment by other agents. However, the compound became incredibly [[Death/Legends|deadly]] when exposed to [[Water/Legends|moisture]], killing members of the [[Human/Legends|Human]], [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]], and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] species within [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] after exposure, regardless of whether it was ingested or simply touched. Moisture also broke down the compound as it intensified its effects, which meant that a single particle per billion could kill hundreds of people if it was inserted into a settlement's water supply.<ref name="Paragon" />

==History==
{{Quote|What exactly are you planning to bring on my ship?''"<br />"''The main ingredients are cyanogen silicate, ardanium and accellerite, but don't worry&mdash;I'm already mixing the solution and we're all still alive.|The Hero of Tython and Doc|<ref name="Looking for a Cure" />}}
Cyanogen silicate was used by the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] as a cauterizing agent as early as the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], and the Sith [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Omen]]'' carried a supply in its [[Medical bay/Legends|sick bay]] before crashing on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] that [[Standard year/Legends|year]]. One of the deck plates in the wreckage became stained with cyanogen silicate, and the Keshiri [[Gorem]] came into contact with the contaminated plate while he searched the crushed sections of the ship. Even though he washed his [[Limb/Legends|hands]], Gorem died minutes afterward&mdash;he only survived long enough to exit the wreckage of the ''Omen'' before he collapsed.<ref name="Paragon" />

The Human [[Seelah Korsin]] had a supply of the compound on the ''Omen'', as did the ship's Sith [[Blood/Legends|pureblood]] [[Quartermaster/Legends|quartermaster]], [[Ravilan Wroth]], and, in [[4985 BBY]], Wroth used the compound to [[Poison/Legends|poison]] the aqueducts of the native Keshiri's [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tetsubal]]. Wroth hoped to use the massacre of Tetsubal's inhabitants to convince the other survivors of the ''Omen''{{'s}} crash that they should separate themselves from the Keshiri population and concentrate on how they would escape the planet. However, Korsin deduced Wroth's hand in the events at Tetsubal, and she ordered her personal [[Aide/Legends|aide]], [[Tilden Kaah]], to use Korsin's own supply of cyanogen silicate to poison several other local water supplies and thereby frame Wroth and his fellow Sith survivors for the massacres. Korsin's plan worked, causing the deaths of a hundred thousand Keshiri, and it resulted in the [[Red Sith Purge|purge]] of all pureblood Sith from Kesh.<ref name="Paragon" />

Around [[3642 BBY]], over a thousand years later, cyanogen silicate was a known compound in the Galactic Republic, and the [[xenopathologist]] [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Archiban Kimble]]&mdash;better known as Doc&mdash;acquired supplies of cyanogen silicate, [[ardanium]], and [[Accellerite/Legends|accellerite]] in his work to cure a [[Suudaa Nem'ro's disease|rare flesh-eating disease]] that afflicted the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Suudaa Nem'ro]]. He brought the chemicals aboard the [[Hero of Tython's Defender-class light corvette|ship]] of his ally, the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]], and completed the mixture there.<ref name="Looking for a Cure" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cyanogen silicate first appeared in [[John Jackson Miller]]'s [[2010]] [[eBook]] ''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Paragon]]''.<ref name="Paragon" />
